dimensions.note: No credentials; attribution explicitly excludes identity.
retain has no entry or completion logging.
Strict parse and invariant construction complete before the sole write.
Tests cover exact persistence, identity exclusion, authority denial, malformed evidence, and contract shape.
retain does not read existing observationId state, so a conflicting replay can overwrite it.
Documentation and fixtures are synthetic and contain no infrastructure identifiers.
Input and persisted schemas are strict and text is bounded.
observation declares infinite lifetime and garbageCollection 50.
The sole writer uses observationId for the observation spec.
No readResource replay/conflict check is performed before writing an observationId.
